primerosPasos.subtitulo: Three steps and your club is ready to show to a business.

identidad.titulo: Upload your logo and tell people who you are
identidad.texto: With your logo and four lines of description, your page already has a face.

equipos.titulo: Add your teams and youth teams
equipos.texto: It’s the first thing a business looks at: how many people your club reaches.

oportunidad.texto: Even if it’s just €50. Without opportunities you don’t show up in search.

solicitudes.todaviaNoHasRecibido: You haven’t received any contact requests yet. When a business writes to you from your public page, it will appear here and you’ll also get an email.
solicitudes.empresasHanEscritoDesde: Businesses that have written to you from your public page. Replying the same day is what closes the most deals.

errores.sesion: Your session has expired. Sign in again and try once more.
errores.checkout: The payment page could not be opened. Please try again in a few minutes.
errores.portal: The subscription management portal could not be opened. Please try again in a few minutes.
errores.sin-suscripcion: You don’t have a subscription to manage yet.
errores.sin-plazas: The founding club places ran out while you were choosing. You can take the season plan, which is the next cheapest.

suscripcion.intro: Your plan, your invoices and your billing details. This is where you change the payment method or cancel, without calling anyone.
suscripcion.confirmada: Subscription confirmed. Everything is up and running.
suscripcion.confirmando: Thank you! We are confirming your subscription with Stripe. It usually takes a few seconds: reload the page in a moment.
suscripcion.pruebaTerminadaTexto: To use your dashboard again and make your page visible again, choose one of the plans below. You don’t lose anything you have saved: it’s all still there waiting for you.
suscripcion.pagoCancelado: You left the payment page without finishing the payment. Nothing has been charged and you can try again whenever you like.
suscripcion.eresFundador: You are founding club no. {numero}: this price will never go up for you.
suscripcion.eligeComoPagar: Choose how you want to pay when your free month ends.
suscripcion.eseDiaSeCobra: on that day the first payment of your plan is charged.
suscripcion.hastaEntoncesNada: until then you won’t be charged anything. We will email you before that date.
suscripcion.siNoEligesPlan: if you haven’t chosen a plan by then, your page stops being visible. Nothing is charged unless you activate it.
suscripcion.visible: Your public page and your opportunities are visible.
suscripcion.noVisible: Your public page and your opportunities are NOT visible right now.
suscripcion.tusFacturasTexto: They are all behind that same button, in the <fuerte>Billing history</fuerte> section: you can download them as PDF, with the tax ID and address you gave when you signed up. You can correct those details there if they change, and the next invoice will already carry the new ones.
suscripcion.accesoGratuitoHasta: You already have free access until {fecha}.
suscripcion.accesoGratuitoTexto: You don’t need to choose a plan or give any card details until then. We will email you before that date so you can decide in good time.
suscripcion.conservasDatos: You keep all your data even if your subscription is not active: only your public page and your opportunities are hidden until you subscribe again. From “Manage subscription” you can change your card, download your invoices, update the club’s tax details or cancel.

selector.empiezas: You start with <fuerte>30 days free</fuerte> and nothing is charged until they are over. If a single sponsor gives you €300, you have already covered the whole year.

privacidad.descargaUnArchivoCon: Download a file with all your account data: club profile, teams, sponsors, opportunities, dossier, contact requests received and the record of your consents.
privacidad.eliminaDeFormaPermanente: Permanently delete your account and all its data. This cannot be undone.
privacidad.motivoAyuda: It helps us improve. It’s not required and doesn’t change anything about the deletion.
privacidad.motivoPlaceholder: We’re stopping for budget reasons, no business wrote to us…
privacidad.seBorranTuPerfil: Your profile, teams, sponsors, opportunities, logo and photos are deleted.
privacidad.seBorranTusSolicitudes: Your contact requests and your sponsorship dossier are deleted.
privacidad.seCancelaDeInmediato: Any active Stripe subscription is cancelled immediately.
privacidad.tuPaginaPublicaDeja: Your public page stops existing. This cannot be undone.
privacidad.datosGuardamosClubComo: What data we keep about your club, how to download it and how to delete your account. None of this depends on being up to date with payments.
privacidad.eliminarTodo: Delete my account and all my data
privacidad.masInformacion: More information about how we handle your data in our <enlace>Privacy Policy</enlace>.

patrocinadores.empresasYaColaboranContigo: The businesses that already work with you. They appear on your public page and in your dossier, and they are your best calling card for the next one: seeing others already on board is what convinces those who aren’t yet.
patrocinadores.completaIdentidad: First fill in your club’s identity (name and town) in <enlace>your profile</enlace> and you’ll be able to add your sponsors.
patrocinadores.ningunPapel: You haven’t saved any documents for this sponsorship yet.
patrocinadores.tope: You have reached the limit of {maximo}. Delete one to upload another.
patrocinadores.formatos: PDF or photo, up to {mb} MB. If you signed it on paper, a photo of the document will do.
patrocinadores.soloLoVesTu: Only you can see this. These files don’t appear on {nombre}’s public page or in your dossier.

recomendaciones.sonOtrasEmpresasNo: They belong to other companies, not ApoyaClub. We suggest them because they solve something for a grassroots club that we don’t do: finding who to show your dossier to.
recomendaciones.siContratasDesdeEste: If you sign up through this link, ApoyaClub receives a commission. We don’t share any of your data with them.

prospectpro.queEs: A tool for pulling lists of businesses by area and sector, with their website and phone number.
prospectpro.paraQue: Your page and your dossier are ready, but they need to be sent to someone. This tells you who: the businesses in your area that fit what you offer.
prospectpro.comoSeActiva: Write to us and we’ll set you up. It’s included in your fee, you don’t pay anything extra.

perfil.anadeCadaEquipoDel: Add each of the club’s teams: sport, age group, gender and whether it’s a first team or a youth team.
perfil.comoSePresentaTu: How your club presents itself to businesses. Name and town are the only required fields.
perfil.competicionesEnLasQue: Competitions the club takes part in
perfil.confirmoQueLasFotos: I confirm that the photos I upload don’t show identifiable minors without consent, or that I have that consent.
perfil.elCorreoDeTu: Your account email always appears on the contact button of your public page. Phone and contact name are optional and only shown if you allow it.
perfil.instalacionesAficionEquiposLo: Facilities, supporters, teams… whatever best represents the club.
perfil.laCategoriaCompeticionesY: The level, competitions and achievements help a business judge the visibility of the sponsorship.
perfil.marcaLaCasillaDe: Tick the box above to be able to add photos.
perfil.soloDatosAgregadosNo: Totals only: you don’t need to break down each team.
perfil.paginaPublicaYaEsta: Your public page is live at <enlace>{ruta}</enlace>. Share it with any businesses you like.
perfil.imagenesTitulo: Badge, cover and photos, in a moment
perfil.imagenesTexto: First save your club’s name and town, down below. As soon as you do, the buttons to upload your badge, cover photo and club photos will appear here.
perfil.avisoMenores: Don’t upload photos in which minors can be clearly identified (for example, close-ups with their face visible) without the consent of their parents or legal guardians, and don’t include their full names in descriptions or titles. Youth team data is always stored as totals, never as records of specific children.
perfil.soloObligatorios: Only the <fuerte>name</fuerte> and the <fuerte>town</fuerte> are required: with those you already have your page. You can fill in the rest whenever you like.
perfil.webVideoRedesVacio: Businesses look at them before writing to you
perfil.contactoVacio: Who businesses call when they visit your profile
perfil.correoContactoAyuda: The one you want businesses to use. If you leave it empty, the email you signed up with is used.
perfil.horarioAyuda: When people can call you. It saves missed calls on both sides.
perfil.mostrarContacto: Show my contact name and phone number on my public page
perfil.mostrarContactoAyuda: Recommended. Businesses that visit your profile look for someone to call: if you untick this they will only see the request form and you’ll take longer to close deals. Your email is always shown, protected so spam bots can’t collect it.
perfil.enQueCompiteAyuda: Examples: Regional League, County League, National Under-18s.
perfil.logrosEquipoAyuda: Promotions, titles, finals. Whole-club achievements go under History.
perfil.dondeJuegaClubPrimero: Where the club plays. It’s the first thing a business looks at when it’s thinking about putting up a banner or a vinyl.
perfil.pabellonCampoPistaGradas: The sports hall, the pitch, the court, the stands, the bar. You can add as many as you like: there’s no limit.
perfil.calleLocalidadPabellonCampo: Street and town of the hall, pitch or court where you play.
perfil.pabellonMunicipalCDeporte: Municipal Sports Hall, 4 Sports Street, Vigo
perfil.pabellon800LocalidadesParque: 800-seat hall, wooden floor, electronic scoreboard and café.
perfil.lineaParaQuienNo: One line, for people who don’t know the age groups. It appears under the photo.
perfil.primerEquipoTemporada2025: First team, 2025/26 season. We got promoted in May.
perfil.masAltaJuegaCada: The highest level each team plays at. Only fill in the one you have.
perfil.fotoAnchaArribaTodo: The wide photo at the very top of your page. Landscape and good quality: it’s the first thing a business sees.
perfil.parteFotoVe: Which part of the photo is shown
perfil.todoEmpresaVeTi: Everything a business sees about you. The more complete it is, the higher you appear in search.
perfil.antesTenias: Previously you had <fuerte>{categoria}</fuerte>. Copy it into the right box and save.

perfil2.accionesSocialesEducativasO: The club’s social, educational or charity work: what makes it more than a sports result.
perfil2.fundacionEHitosDestacados: How the club was founded and the highlights of its history.
perfil2.personasALasQue: A hand-written estimate. If you record attendance at your matches, that figure is far more convincing.
perfil2.seguidoresEnRedesAlcance: Social media followers, members, average match attendance and estimated reach.
perfil2.sociosAyuda: People who pay a membership fee, whether they play or not. Kept separate from players and families: they are never added together.
perfil2.patrocinadoresDescripcion: The businesses that already work with you. Showing them is what convinces the ones that don’t yet: add all you have, sort them into categories and say in two lines what they contribute.
perfil2.avisadaEl: Notified on {fecha}. Each business is only written to once.
perfil2.anadeCorreoParaAvisar: Add the business’s email above and you’ll be able to send them a thank-you with the link to your page.
perfil2.leLlegaraCorreo: They’ll get an email <fuerte>in your club’s name</fuerte> thanking them for their support, with the link to your page so they can see how they appear. It’s only sent once.
perfil2.confirmoRelacion: I confirm that this business works with my club and that I have a relationship with that email address.
perfil2.correoEmpresaAyuda: Only you can see it: it’s never published. It’s used to send them the thank-you with the link to your page.
perfil2.alGuardarSeEnviara: When you save, if you’ve entered an email, a thank-you for their support will be sent <fuerte>in your club’s name</fuerte> with the link to your page. It’s only sent once.
perfil2.noEnviarCorreo: Don’t send the email to this business
perfil2.noEnviarCorreoAyuda: Tick this if you’d rather tell them yourself, or if you haven’t spoken to them yet. You can send it later from their record.
perfil2.categoriaAyuda: How it’s grouped on your public page.
perfil2.nombreCategoriaAyuda: For example: Technical sponsor, Official supplier.
perfil2.queAportaAyuda: Two lines: what they sponsor, since when or why they support you. 400 characters maximum.
perfil2.buenRitmoCadaApartado: Good progress. Every section you fill in moves you up in search.
perfil2.fichaAunTienePoca: Your profile still has little information, and that puts you lower in search.
perfil2.enlaceYoutubeVimeoDonde: Link to YouTube, Vimeo or wherever you have it.

avisoSuscripcion.sinActivar: You haven’t activated your subscription yet. In the meantime, your public page and your opportunities aren’t visible to businesses.
avisoSuscripcion.terminada: Your subscription has ended. Your public page and your opportunities are no longer visible.
avisoSuscripcion.problemaCobro: There’s a problem charging your subscription. Update your payment method so you don’t lose visibility.
avisoSuscripcion.pagoIncompleto: Your subscription payment couldn’t be completed.
avisoSuscripcion.cancelada: You have cancelled your subscription: you’ll keep access until {fecha}.
avisoSuscripcion.ultimoDia: Today is the last day of your trial. From tomorrow you’ll need a subscription to keep using the dashboard.
avisoSuscripcion.quedanDias: {dias, plural, one {You have # day of your trial left.} other {You have # days of your trial left.}} When it ends you’ll need a subscription to keep using the dashboard.

oportunidades.aQuePublicoO: Which audience or goal this opportunity speaks to. You can tick several.
oportunidades.aQueSeRefiere: What the amount refers to. It helps businesses compare budgets in search.
oportunidades.agrupaLaOportunidadDentro: Groups the opportunity within the club’s catalogue.
oportunidades.comoPuedeAportarLa: How the business can contribute, besides money.
oportunidades.compartirPlantillaAyuda: Share the title and description with other clubs as a template. The amount isn’t shared.
oportunidades.describeConDetalleQue: Describe in detail what the business gets in return for its sponsorship.
oportunidades.ejemplosPatrocinioDelDescanso: Examples: “Half-time sponsorship at home matches”, “Youth teams’ training shirt”.
oportunidades.esLoPrimeroQue: It’s the first thing a business looks at: whether this is the club’s main sponsorship or a small partnership. It can be used as a filter in search.
oportunidades.loFijasTuLa: You set it: the platform doesn’t suggest or impose prices.
oportunidades.plazas: Is it shared between several businesses?
oportunidades.plazasAyuda: Number of sponsors you’re looking for. Leave it empty if it’s for a single business. Example: 10 businesses at €100 each for the Christmas tournament.
oportunidades.plazasCubiertasAyuda: You keep track of it: the platform doesn’t reserve places or charge anything.
oportunidades.siLaEmpresaQue: Whether the business that takes it will be the only one from its sector. Examples: “cars”, “insurance”, “supermarkets”. Leave it empty if there’s no exclusivity.
oportunidades.ofrezcoPatrocinioTexto: I give the business visibility and it contributes money.
oportunidades.necesitoServicio: I need a service or product
oportunidades.necesitoServicioTexto: Physio, coach hire, photographer, equipment… and I give visibility in return.
oportunidades.queNecesitasAyuda: So that a business in that field finds you when it searches for what it does.
oportunidades.fotosAyuda: Optional, up to three. What really convinces a business is seeing the wall where its banner will go, the bus or the kit.
oportunidades.queRecibeEmpresa: What the business gets and who does what
oportunidades.queRecibeEmpresaResumen: The detail of the deal, line by line. You don’t need it to publish, but it’s what makes the business understand what you’re offering.
oportunidades.frecuenciaAyuda: How often: monthly, per home match…
oportunidades.desdeHastaAyuda: Optional. When it starts and when it ends.
oportunidades.masDetallesResumen: Level, places, exclusivity, who it’s aimed at… None of this is needed to publish: you can fill it in later.
oportunidades.equipoAsociadoAyuda: If the opportunity is for a specific team (the first team, a youth team). Leave it blank if it’s for the whole club.
oportunidades.cuantosColaboradoresAyuda: If one is enough, leave it empty. From two upwards, a bar shows how many you’ve already got.
oportunidades.introPagina: What your club offers a business in exchange for sponsorship, and what it needs in exchange for visibility. It’s the only part of your profile where a business can take action.
oportunidades.completaIdentidad: First fill in the club’s identity (name and town) in <enlace>your profile</enlace> to be able to publish sponsorship opportunities.
oportunidades.anadeAlgoTuyo: <fuerte>Add something of your own before publishing it.</fuerte> How many people come to your matches, how many teams you have, how many followers. If every club publishes the same text, the business won’t know why it should choose you.
oportunidades.ningunaCreada: You haven’t created any opportunities yet. Start with the button above.

editor.empresaRecibeAyuda: One line per item, with the quantity where there is one. It’s the first thing someone deciding whether they’re interested looks at.
editor.quienHaceQueAyuda: What needs doing for this to work, and who is responsible for each thing. It avoids the “I thought you were doing that”.

galeria.yaTienesTodas: You already have {n} photos. Remove one to upload another.

dossier.ademasDeLasDisponibles: As well as the available ones, you can include reserved opportunities: it’s your sales document.
dossier.dejaloEnBlancoPara: Leave it blank so the link never expires.
dossier.generaElPdfAl: Generates the PDF instantly with the selection above.
dossier.laPortadaConTu: The cover with your branding and the ApoyaClub footer always appear, whatever you choose here.
dossier.seAbreDirectamenteEn: It opens straight in the browser, no sign-in needed: ideal for sending by email or WhatsApp.
dossier.noPodidoGenerarPdf: The PDF couldn’t be generated. Please try again.
dossier.noPodidoGenerarWord: The Word file couldn’t be generated. Please try again.
dossier.documentoLePasasEmpresa: The document you hand to a business: your club in a PDF, with the figures and opportunities you choose. It also comes as a Word file, in case you want to tweak it.

identidad.descripcion: Who we are, location and contact.

equipos.descripcion: Sport, age group and level of each team.

audiencia.descripcion: How many people you reach, with where each figure comes from and without adding them together.

patrocinadores.descripcion: Brands that already trust the club.

dossier.sinDatos: You haven’t added any data yet.
dossier.sinOportunidades: You don’t have any published opportunities yet. You can create them in <enlace>Opportunities</enlace>.
dossier.pdfYWord: The <fuerte>PDF</fuerte> is the one you send to a business: it looks the same on any screen and doesn’t get messed up. The <fuerte>Word</fuerte> file is for you: open it to change text, add photos or move sections around, then save it as a PDF from Word itself.
dossier.completaIdentidad: First fill in the club’s identity (name and town) in <enlace>your profile</enlace> to be able to generate your sponsorship dossier.

metricas.aparicionesAyuda: Times your club has appeared in a business’s results.
metricas.visitasAyuda: People who have opened your club’s public page.
metricas.dossieresAyuda: Opens of the dossier link you share.
metricas.solicitudesAyuda: Businesses that have asked to get in touch.
metricas.vacioTexto: Businesses find clubs through their published opportunities. Publish at least one and share your link: that’s what moves the needle most.
metricas.contactosAyuda: Times someone has opened your contact details. It’s the step right before writing to you.
metricas.personasHanAbiertoPagina: People who have opened your page. Reloading doesn’t count twice.
metricas.hanPulsadoParaVer: Clicked to see your phone and email. It’s the step right before writing to you.
metricas.desdeQueEstas: Since you joined ApoyaClub: {visitas, plural, one {# visit} other {# visits}} and {contactos, plural, one {# view} other {# views}} of your contact details.

publico.partidosApuntados: {n, plural, one {# match recorded} other {# matches recorded}}
publico.sobrePartidosEnCasa: {n, plural, one {Based on # home match} other {Based on # home matches}}
publico.equipoPorEquipoTexto: Not every team draws the same crowd, and a business sponsoring the senior women’s team wants that team’s number, not the club average.
publico.sinEquipoNota: Matches without a team assigned are from before you could choose one. They count towards the season total, but not towards any team.
publico.mesAMesTexto: To see whether the crowd grows as the season goes on.
publico.fichaYaEnsena: Your profile shows an average attendance of <fuerte>{media}</fuerte> people, which is exactly what these matches give.
publico.fichaPone: Your profile says <fuerte>{enFicha} people</fuerte>. These matches give <fuerte>{media}</fuerte>.
publico.fichaSinMedia: You haven’t entered an average attendance on your profile yet. These matches give <fuerte>{media}</fuerte>.
publico.usarMedia: Use this average on my profile
publico.sinEquipos: You don’t have any teams on your profile yet. <enlace>Add them here</enlace> and they’ll appear in this list.
publico.estimacion: You don’t need an exact figure: an honest estimate of the crowd will do, and it’s what makes the average on your profile defensible.
publico.ningunPartido: You haven’t recorded any matches yet. Start with the last one you played at home.
publico.personasEnPartidos: {n, plural, one {{personas} people in # match} other {{personas} people in # matches}}
publico.apuntaCuantaGenteHubo: Record how many people came to each match. That way the average attendance on your profile is no longer a guess but a figure you can stand behind in front of a business.

tareas.todoLoPrometidoTexto: Grouped by business. Those with something overdue come first.
tareas.nadaApuntado: You haven’t added anything yet. Start with what you promised your main sponsor: if it’s written down, it gets done.
tareas.desdeAyuda: If it’s something that lasts, like a board.
tareas.fechaLimiteAyuda: The day it has to be done by.
tareas.anadirALaLista: {n, plural, one {Add to the list} other {Add all # to the list}}
tareas.apuntarPrometido: Record what you’ve promised a business
tareas.apuntarPrometidoTexto: You can add everything at once: the two posts, the video and the visit all go together in the same sponsorship.
tareas.empresaAyuda: Your sponsors and the businesses you’ve already added here.
tareas.noHaceFaltaRegistrada: It doesn’t need to be registered on ApoyaClub.

informe.terminadas: {n, plural, one {You’ve finished with a sponsor: send them the report} other {You’ve finished with # sponsors: send them the report}}
informe.terminadasPorQue: The sooner the better: right after it ends it’s still fresh in their mind, and that’s the moment to show what came of it. Later on it’s just a reminder of something old.

mitad.titulo: You’re halfway through the season: a good time to send the progress report
mitad.porQue: There’s still time to fix what’s missing. If you wait until June, whatever isn’t done can’t be fixed — only reported.

final.titulo: The season is ending: send the report before talking about renewing
final.porQue: That’s when the business decides whether to carry on. Better that it decides looking at what it got, not at what it remembers.

informe.ningunInforme: you haven’t downloaded one for them yet
informe.loMandasTu: You send the report yourself, from your email or on WhatsApp. Download it and attach it with a couple of lines of your own: it lands much better than an automatic email.
informe.pdfTitulo: Download as PDF what you’ve done for {empresa}
informe.wordTitulo: Download as Word what you’ve done for {empresa}, in case you want to tweak it

tareas.repetirTitulo: Creates a copy dated one month later
tareas.enlacePruebaAyuda: The link to the post, the video or the photo. It’s what you’ll show the business when it’s time to renew.

cabecera.texto: What you’ve promised each business and by when. It’s what lets you show in June what they got in return — and get them to renew.

hoy.tituloVencidas: {n, plural, one {Today’s to-do — and # is overdue} other {Today’s to-do — and # are overdue}}

logo.porQue: It’s the first thing seen in search. Without a logo, your profile looks unfinished.

descripcion.titulo: Write a description of the club
descripcion.porQue: Four lines about who you are. It’s what the business reads before deciding.

patrocinadores.porQue: Seeing that other businesses already trust you is what convinces a new one most.

equipos.porQue: Without teams, a business can’t tell how many people its sponsorship reaches.

fotos.porQue: A photo of a packed match is worth more than any figure.

cantera.porQue: Children and families are what local shops are after: they’re customers nearby.

audiencia.porQue: It’s the number a business compares with what an advert costs.

redes.porQue: Businesses look at them before writing to you.

nivel.titulo: Say what level and competitions you play in
nivel.porQue: It puts the club in context: a regional league isn’t the same as a national one.

historia.porQue: Year founded and a couple of milestones. Years of history build trust.

comunidad.titulo: Add what you do for the community
comunidad.porQue: Many businesses sponsor for this, not for the advertising.

web.porQue: If you don’t have one, your Facebook or Instagram page will do.

video.porQue: A minute of a match or a season highlights reel.

correo.loEnviasTu: We write it; you send it from your own email, so the reply comes to you.
correo.cambialo: Change it to suit you before sending it. Anything in square brackets needs filling in.
correo.quedariaMejor: This email would work better if you fill in:
correo.sinDireccion: We didn’t find an address in their details, so it will open blank.

familia.pista: Parents, former players, committee members. The ones who already pick up when you call.

rival.pista: They’ve already decided sports sponsorship works for them. You don’t need to sell them the idea.

barrio.pista: The ones who see your families walk past every Saturday on the way to the sports hall.

conocido.pista: Someone you know through another route.

objetivos.tocaHoy: Due today — it was set for {fecha}
objetivos.notasEjemplo: Her son plays in the under-11s. They gave us kit last year.
objetivos.porDondeEmpezarTexto: You don’t need a list of a hundred businesses. You need fifteen that someone at your club can call by name. Look at them in this order:

cabecera.texto: Your list of businesses: who you want to call, who among your people knows them and when to try again. What usually gets lost isn’t a “no”, it’s a “call me in September” that nobody wrote down.

plazo.meses: {meses, plural, one {One month to go} other {About # months to go}}

mensaje.desde: You’ve been with us since {anio}, {anios, plural, one {one season} other {# seasons}}.
mensaje.estaTemporada: Thank you for being with us this season.
mensaje.osEscribo: I’m writing from {club}. {desde} Your support has made a difference at the club and first of all we wanted to say thank you.
mensaje.cerrando: We’re wrapping up the {temporada} season and I’d like to know whether you want to carry on with us. If you like, I’ll put together what we did this year and what we can offer you next year, and we can go over it with no commitment.
mensaje.llamada: Would it suit you if I called this week?

renovaciones.cuandoEscribirAyuda: Set it before the agreement ends, with time to talk it over.
renovaciones.queAcordasteisAyuda: What today is only in the head of whoever signed it. When the committee changes, this is all that’s left.
renovaciones.queAcordasteisEjemplo: €600 per season, logo on the shirt and two posts a month.
renovaciones.puntoDePartida: A starting point, not an email to send as it is: change it to the way you talk before sending it.

cabecera.texto: How long each sponsorship lasts and when to talk about it. Hardly any sponsor is lost because they say no: they’re lost because nobody asked again in time.

renovaciones.avisan: {n, plural, one {You have <fuerte>#</fuerte> renewal that needs you to write now.} other {You have <fuerte>#</fuerte> renewals that need you to write now.}}
renovaciones.completaIdentidad: First fill in your club’s identity in <enlace>your profile</enlace>.
renovaciones.sinPatrocinadores: You haven’t added any sponsors yet. Add them in <enlace>Sponsors</enlace> and you’ll be able to keep track of their renewals here.

alcance.cuantaGenteLlegasDicho: How many people you reach, put in a way that stands up to questions. Figures are never added together here: the same person can be a member, a player’s parent and a social media follower, and counting them three times is noticed straight away.
alcance.siTuvierasDecirSola: If you had to give a single figure, it would be this one
alcance.estoHacePatrocinadorRenueve: This is what makes a sponsor renew: not liking the club, but being shown that this year there are more people than last.
alcance.teFaltaParaSirve: What’s missing, and what it’s for
alcance.nadaEstoObligatorioCada: None of this is compulsory. Everything you fill in is one less question the business will ask you.
alcance.fichaTodaviaNoTiene: Your profile doesn’t have anything to calculate with yet. These are the things that change the report most, in order.
alcance.comparacion: From an average of {antes} people in {temporadaAntes} to {ahora} in {temporadaAhora}: <fuerte>{signo}{diferencia} people ({signo}{porcentaje}%)</fuerte>.
alcance.mismasCifras: These same figures are the ones in the audience section of your <enlace>dossier</enlace>. They’re calculated in a single place, so the two documents can’t say different things.

informe.avisoDeOrigen: Figures provided by the club. ApoyaClub does not verify them.

contado.explicacion: Attendance recorded match by match. It’s the only part that doesn’t rely on anyone trusting a hand-written figure.

declarado.explicacion: Figures from the club’s profile. Listed one by one and never added up: the same person can be a member, a player’s parent and a social media follower.

deducido.explicacion: Calculations made with the figures above. The full sum is written out so anyone can check it.

procedencia.unEquipo: players in the only team with a headcount on the profile
procedencia.variosEquipos: adding up the players in {n} teams on the profile
procedencia.mediaDe: average of {n, plural, one {# recorded match} other {# recorded matches}} in the {temporada} season
procedencia.estimacion: estimate written by the club on its profile
procedencia.mayorGrupo: the largest of the club’s groups, not their sum

cuentas.personasDistintas: the highest figure the club has ({grupo}: {valor}). Groups aren’t added together because the same person can be in several.
cuentas.asistencias: {media} people × {n, plural, one {# home match} other {# home matches}}. These are times someone went to a match, not different people: someone who never misses one counts {n, plural, one {# time} other {# times}}.

publico.porQue: It’s the only figure that doesn’t depend on being believed: you record it match by match and it’s shown with the count behind it. It carries the most weight with a business.

masPartidos.porQue: With {n, plural, one {# match} other {# matches}} the average still moves a lot. From {minimo} upwards the figure holds up, and with a whole season it can be compared with the next.

jugadores.que: How many players each team has
jugadores.porQue: It’s the first thing a business thinking of putting its name on a shirt asks: how many people will be wearing it.

socios.que: How many members the club has
socios.porQue: It’s the figure that best shows how many local people the club reaches, because it includes the neighbour who pays the fee without anyone in the family playing.

familias.que: How many families are behind the youth teams
familias.porQue: Behind every child there are parents, grandparents and siblings who go to matches and shop locally. For a local business it’s the deciding figure.

redes.porQue: A post thanking the sponsor is the cheapest thing a club can offer, and without this figure nothing can be priced.

llano.publicoEnCasa: Each home match is watched by around {cifra} people.
llano.publico: Each match is watched by around {cifra} people.
llano.jugadores: {cifra} players wear the club’s kit every week.
llano.familias: Behind the youth teams there are {cifra} families: parents, grandparents and siblings who come to matches.
llano.socios: The club has {cifra} members in the local area.
llano.redes: When the club posts on {red}, {cifra} people can see it.

conocida.etiqueta: A business that already knows you
conocida.cuando: A player’s dad, the café across the road, a former member.

fria.etiqueta: A business that doesn’t know you
fria.cuando: A local shop you haven’t dealt with yet.

servicio.etiqueta: Ask for a service, not money
servicio.cuando: The physio, the van, the printer, the meals.

insistir.cuando: You wrote and they haven’t replied. After seven to ten days.

responder.cuando: They’ve written to you. It’s the email with most at stake and the one that usually comes out worst.

renovar.etiqueta: Renew with someone who already supports you
renovar.cuando: Before the season ends, not after.

cierre.cuando: Leave the door open for next year.

cifras.publico: an average of {n} people at every home match

huecos.cifras: How many of you there are: players, families, members or match attendance
huecos.dossier: The link to your dossier, so the business can see what you offer at a glance

comun.fraseCifras: This year we have {cifras}. All of them are local people who see our shirts and our social media every weekend.
comun.presentacionCompleta: I’m writing from {club}, a {deporte} club in {localidad}.
comun.presentacionLocalidad: I’m writing from {club}, a club in {localidad}.
comun.enlaceDossier: Here’s who we are and what we offer, in two minutes: {url}
comun.enlaceFicha: Here’s our page, in case you’d like to take a look: {url}

conocida.propuesta: We’re looking for local businesses that would like to be with us this season. It doesn’t have to be much: there’s everything from small things up to main sponsor, and in-kind support works for us too.
conocida.llamada: Would it be all right if I called you this week so we can go over it in five minutes?

fria.asunto1: {club}: would you like to be on our shirts?
fria.asunto2: A club from {localidad} would like to work with you
fria.asunto2SinLocalidad: A local club would like to work with you
fria.porQue: I’m writing because you’re based in {localidad} and we think it could suit you. Advertising with a community club isn’t like advertising online: it’s seen by the people who then walk through your door, and it links you to something they care about.
fria.porQueSinLocalidad: I’m writing because you’re local and we think it could suit you. Advertising with a community club isn’t like advertising online: it’s seen by the people who then walk through your door, and it links you to something they care about.
fria.respuesta: If you’re interested, just reply to this email and I’ll tell you the options. And if it’s not the right time, let me know that too and I won’t bother you again.

servicio.asunto2: A partnership with no money involved
servicio.asunto3: {club}: we’d like to propose an exchange
servicio.necesidadHueco: What we need isn’t money, it’s [say exactly what here: physiotherapy for home matches, a van for away trips, the banners for the sports hall…].
servicio.aCambio: In return we give you the same visibility as any sponsor: your logo, your name on our social media and at the sports hall, and our people talking about it.
servicio.llamada: Shall we talk? A short call will sort it out.

insistir.asunto1: I wrote to you a few days ago — {club}
insistir.asunto2: Have you had a chance to look?
insistir.asunto3: Trying once more (and then I’ll stop)
insistir.recordatorio: I wrote to you a few days ago from {club} and I’m not sure it reached you, emails do get lost.
insistir.sinLata: I don’t want to pester you: if you just tell me it’s not the right time, that’s fine and I won’t write again.
insistir.siEsQueSi: And if it’s a yes, tell me when suits you for a call and we’ll go over it in five minutes.

responder.gracias: Thank you very much for writing to us. Here’s what we can do.
responder.respuestaHueco: [Answer what they asked here, with specific names and numbers. It’s the part with most at stake.]
responder.llamada: If it suits you, give me a day and a time and I’ll call you. And if you’d rather see it in person, we’re happy to come over.

renovar.asunto1: Shall we carry on together next season?
renovar.gracias: The season is coming to an end and I wanted to write before it slipped my mind: thank you for being with {club} this year.
renovar.hecho: This is what we’ve done with you: {detalle}
renovar.hechoHueco: [Tell them here what they got: the posts, the banner, the mentions. If you have it in Tasks, take it from there.]
renovar.seguir: We’d like to carry on next year and, if you want, we can rethink what we do so it works even better for you.
renovar.hablamos: Shall we talk about it one of these days?

cierre.gracias: Thank you for replying, really. A timely no is worth much more than silence.
cierre.puerta: If things change at any point, we’re here. And if you know anyone it might suit, I’d be grateful if you passed our page on to them.
